answer: Because the cipher solution is checked at the sparrow gate and logged, the river audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 21 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence forfeits the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. That is 2 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
